item.title: Sell Domain & Setup Chaturbate Affiliate
item.description:
250-750 USD | I own mrmask.com through GoDaddy and want two things handled in one smooth session. First, the domain has to be properly listed for sale on GoDaddy’s auction platform so it is publicly visible, searchable, and purchase-ready with the correct reserve or “buy it now” price in place. Second, while the domain is still in my possession, I would like to use the site to earn through Chaturbate’s affiliate program.
That means you will: • Configure the GoDaddy listing, including DNS or nameserver changes GoDaddy may require and any descriptive copy that helps the domain attract buyers. • Create a Chaturbate affiliate link under my account (this is a custom program, not Amazon or ClickBank) and place it so that anyone who types mrmask.com lands on a simple, compliant landing page that forwards traffic—and tracks commissions—straight to Chaturbate.
Please handle the technical steps (affiliate dashboard setup, link generation, DNS, forwarding, and any HTML/WordPress or plain-HTML landing page work) and show me where I can monitor clicks and earnings.
Once both parts are live and tested, send me a quick walkthrough or screen-share recording so I can keep tabs on the listing status and affiliate stats myself.

We need the ability to increase or decrease pricing across all products with one click or by percentage.
Examples:
Increase all products by 10% Decrease all products by 5% Quickly adjust storewide profit margins without editing products individually Industry
This is an adult merchandise ecommerce store. Applicants must be comfortable working within this industry and understand any platform restrictions that may apply.

Maximum budget: $200 CAD
Please do not apply if your pricing is significantly above budget.
To Apply
Send:
Examples of ecommerce websites you have built XML feed projects you have completed Platform you recommend (WooCommerce, Shopify, etc.) Estimated completion time Your total project price Long-Term Opportunity

Additional XML feed integrations Store maintenance Product feed troubleshooting Website upgrades Future ecommerce projects
We are ready to hire immediately for the right candidate. Preference will be given to applicants who can demonstrate successful XML feed automation and dropshipping experience with live examples.

item.title: AI Travel Copilot Development
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I’m building a web-based copilot that can shoulder every logistical detail of a trip, from the first spark of an idea to the last calendar reminder. The agent must fluently handle search, reasoning and transactional tasks in one seamless flow: suggesting where to go, mapping out days, reserving everything, then keeping my schedule tidy.
Platform • Primary interface: modern, responsive web app (desktop & mobile-friendly).
Core planning intelligence • Itinerary creation that adapts in real time to user preferences, time constraints and budget caps. • Destination recommendations generated through data-driven insights and conversational AI. • Travel budget management with live price tracking and clear cost breakdowns.
Booking automation • Flight booking • Hotel booking • Car-rental booking In addition, the agent must schedule meetings, secure restaurant reservations and sync the full agenda to Google Calendar / Outlook without clashes.
Key expectations – Natural-language chat powered by GPT-style LLM or similar. – Secure integration with major GDS / OTA APIs plus OpenTable (or equivalent) for restaurants. – Calendar read/write and conflict detection. – Transparent error handling so the user always knows what succeeded or needs attention. – Clean, maintainable codebase, documented and deployable on a mainstream cloud stack.
Delivery criteria 1. Working web application hosted on a test environment. 2. Source code with setup instructions. 3. Short demo video or live walkthrough proving the agent can: • propose an itinerary, • book a flight + hotel + car on sandbox endpoints, • reserve a restaurant, • add all events to a calendar.
If you’re confident integrating AI with travel and calendar APIs while keeping UX frictionless, let’s get this rolling.

item.title: Minimal Fashion E-commerce Website
item.description:
750-1500 CAD | I'm launching a minimal fashion brand and I'm looking for an experienced developer to build a fully functional e-commerce website.
The look should feel clean and premium, with a monochrome palette of white, grey and charcoal.
The site will need a homepage that introduces the brand and features selected products, a collection page with filters and sorting, and a product page with photos, colour and size options, and a size guide.
It should also include a shopping cart, a smooth and simple checkout, and a search feature that helps visitors find products quickly, along with About, Journal and policy pages.
I have around 24 products to start with.
The main focus is the desktop experience, but the site must also work well on mobile.
If you're interested, please share two or three e-commerce websites you've built.

item.title: Build Scalable Shopify Marketplace
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m putting together a full-featured, multi-vendor marketplace on Shopify and need a partner who can take it from idea to launch while keeping future growth in mind. The core of the project is technical—configuring vendor registration with a solid verification process, individual storefronts, and percentage-based split payments that deposit the right share to each vendor automatically.
Beyond the build, I also want a clear marketing engine ready on day one. That means laying the groundwork for organic search (onsite SEO, structured data, high-value landing pages), mapping out content that attracts vendors and shoppers alike, and setting up social media profiles plus ad accounts so we can move quickly on paid traffic once the platform is live.
Please include in your proposal: • Your recommended Shopify apps or custom code approach for vendor verification and automated commissions • How you’ll structure the payment workflow to keep transaction fees transparent • A timeline that covers marketplace setup, QA, soft launch, and full public launch • A phased marketing plan that blends content, social, and PPC, noting any early-stage quick wins vs. long-term SEO work • An estimate of total cost, broken into milestones, with options for scaling features or ad spend as the customer base grows
I want everything documented so future enhancements—additional payment gateways, loyalty programs, new ad channels—can bolt on without a full rebuild. Looking forward to seeing how you would tackle both the technical and promotional sides of this project.

item.title: Lightweight Custom CMS Development
item.description: 250-750 USD | I'm looking for a developer to build a custom content management system (CMS) for my business website. I don't need anything as heavy as WordPress, just something clean and simple that my team can use to add and update content without touching any code. Here's what I need it to do: • Users can log in with different roles (admin, editor, author) • Create, edit, and delete pages and blog posts using an easy rich text editor • A media library to upload and manage images and files¬ • Organize posts with categories and tags • Save content as a draft, publish it, or schedule it for later • SEO fields for each page and post (meta title, description, and URL slug) • Filter content so we can quickly find what we need: o by author o by status (Draft, Published, Scheduled) o by category o by date (this week, this month, or a custom date range) • A simple dashboard showing recent posts, drafts, and scheduled content • A clean public-facing website that displays the published pages and posts I'm flexible on the tech stack. React with Node.js or Laravel would be great, but if you have a better suggestion, I'm open to it. Both the admin panel and the website should work well on mobile too. When it's done, I'd like the full source code on GitHub, the site deployed and running, and a short guide on how to set it up and use it. I'd also appreciate a couple of weeks of support afterward in case any bugs show up. Timeline: Let me know what's realistic for you If you're interested, please send me a few examples of similar work you've done (CMS projects, admin panels, or blogs), how long you think it'll take, and how you'd split the payment into milestones. To make sure you've read the whole post, please start your proposal with the word "CONTENT." Looking forward to hearing from you!

item.title: Zenoti POS Setup for Spa
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | I'm looking for an experienced Zenoti consultant to review and rebuild our setup and train our team. We're a two-location day spa in Ohio. We went live on Zenoti in June 2026, but much of the system isn't set up correctly or isn't being used, so we'd like to start fresh.
This is a short-term project, estimated at 4-6 weeks. Remote work is fine. On-site visits are a plus.
Scope of work: - Review our current setup and rebuild it correctly: services, pricing, durations, rooms/equipment, user roles and permissions across both locations - Appointment scheduling, provider schedules, online booking, and automated reminders - Front desk and checkout: POS workflows, payments, refunds, end-of-day closeout, cash drawer reconciliation - Memberships, packages, gift cards, and loyalty programs - Provider commissions, tips, and payroll reports - Client profiles, intake forms, and marketing campaigns - Retail product setup and inventory tracking - Daily, weekly, and monthly management reports, including reports that tie to our accounting - Hands-on training for our manager and front desk staff, plus simple written guides
Requirements: - Hands-on experience configuring Zenoti for spas, salons, or medspas (required) - Experience training non-technical staff - Multi-location experience preferred - Available during US Eastern business hours for live training sessions
In your bid, please include: - Zenoti businesses you've set up or supported, and which modules you configured - A flat project price or hourly rate with estimated hours - Your availability over the next 4-6 weeks

item.title: Comprehensive WordPress Site Overhaul
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | My WordPress site needs a full, end-to-end refresh. I want the layout modernised, pages loading noticeably faster, and every plugin, theme and core file kept fully patched so security is never an after-thought. Above all, I’m aiming to elevate functionality—anything that streamlines the user journey or adds smart features is on the table.
Here’s what I expect you to handle:
• Design & layout – refine the theme, adjust templates, and polish the UI/UX so the site looks clean on all devices. • Performance & speed – implement caching, image optimisation, code minification and database cleanup to achieve sub-2-second loads and a 90+ score on Google PageSpeed Insights. • Security & updates – harden WordPress with best-practice measures (firewalls, brute-force protection, secure login), audit existing plugins, remove bloat, and set up automated, version-controlled updates.
I’m comfortable with widely used optimisation and security tools such as WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, Sucuri, Wordfence, Elementor, Advanced Custom Fields—pick what best suits the job. Custom PHP or JavaScript tweaks are welcome where plugins fall short.
Deliverables are complete once the refreshed site is live on my hosting, fully tested across desktop and mobile, and I receive a short hand-off document outlining the changes, settings, and any future maintenance steps.
If you have a proven track record of turning slow, dated WordPress installs into fast, secure, feature-rich sites, I’d love to see examples and jump right in.

item.title: Halal E-Commerce Store Development
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m ready to launch Halal World Depot as a full-featured online store dedicated to 100 % Halal meat, poultry, and grocery items, shipped nationwide in cold-packed boxes. The build will be on Shopify, but I’m open to complementary full-stack work if a feature demands it.
Security and seamless payment processing come first. Every element—from SSL and PCI-compliant gateways through to tokenised subscriptions—must be rock-solid before we go live. A traditional, classic visual style is what I have in mind: clean typography, warm tones, and an intuitive layout that feels trustworthy to shoppers who may be new to ordering meat online.
Core functionality I need delivered: • Product catalogue with clear categories, best-seller flags, and filtering • “Build Your Box” configurator that calculates real-time weights and pricing • Subscribe-and-Save option that integrates with the chosen payment gateway • Streamlined, secure checkout with address validation and shipment tracking • Fully responsive templates optimised for mobile first but polished on desktop • Built-in blog and review sections I can update through the Shopify admin
I’ll judge proposals primarily on relevant past work—please link to live e-commerce sites you’ve secured and scaled, especially any food or subscription projects. If your portfolio demonstrates bulletproof checkout flows and classic design sensibilities, we’re likely a great fit.
Once the initial store is stable, I’ll look to you for ongoing support and feature improvements, so reusable, well-documented code is essential.

item.title: TMS (TRUCK SOFTWARE MANAGMENT SOFTWARE)
item.description:
250-750 USD | TRUCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM SOFTWARE. This Website will have full TMS Portal App 1. Full TMS Portal: • Interactive Dispatch Board: Load lifecycle management (Assigned \rightarrow At Pickup \rightarrow En Route \rightarrow Delivered \rightarrow Invoiced \rightarrow Paid), load creation modal, and rate-per-mile calculators. • AI Rate Con Parsing Suite: Interactive file parser supporting automated data extraction (Broker, Rate, FSC, Stops, Equipment) directly into dispatched loads. • Driver & Fleet Management: Track trucks, trailers, and drivers with live CDL/Medical Expiration badge alerts. • Driver Settlement Engine: Automated gross-to-net pay breakdown accounting for dispatch fees, factoring, advances, fuel, escrow, and PDF statement preview. • Invoicing & Factoring: Invoicing center
with 1-click factoring packet generation and status management. • IFTA Quarterly Mileage Calculator: State-by-state mileage log, fuel purchase tracking, and automated state tax report summary. • Compliance & Document Vault: Proactive expiration warnings (<30 days alert tags) and document storage tracker. • Live Fleet GPS Map Simulator: Interactive visual tracking canvas for real-time fleet position updating.

item.title: Business WordPress Site
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to launch a new WordPress-based business website that showcases our products and lets customers buy with ease. The core of the build is a dedicated product section that must include:
• a clean, searchable product catalog • a fully functional shopping cart for fast checkout • visible product reviews so visitors see real feedback
WooCommerce (or an equally robust plugin) is the natural fit here, but if you have a better tool chain in mind, tell me why and how it improves speed or security. I already have hosting and a fresh WordPress install waiting; your job is to configure everything, choose or tweak a responsive theme so the shop looks polished on mobile and desktop, and make sure the catalog, cart, and review features work smoothly end-to-end.
Once finished, I’ll need a brief hand-off guide or video so my team can add new items and moderate reviews without digging into code.
Let me know the theme or stack you propose, any premium plugins you’d recommend, and a realistic timeline for first draft, revisions, and final hand-over.

item.title: Shopify Store Readiness Audit
item.description:
750-1500 GBP | I run three separate Shopify storefronts and need confirmation that every component is truly ready to start taking orders. My priority is to know, with certainty, that all systems are configured correctly—from the first click through to a completed payment—and to identify anything that might block a sale.
Current situation • PayPal and Shopify Payments are enabled, yet I have not tested the checkout flow on any of the stores. • I want assurance that user experience, product pages, shipping, taxes, legal pages, and tracking pixels are all aligned and functional.
Scope of work 1. Conduct a full-stack audit on each store: theme performance, navigation, product listings, SEO basics, policy pages, shipping and tax settings, and any launch-critical configurations. 2. Simulate real purchases to validate both PayPal and credit/debit card processing through Shopify Payments, documenting every step. 3. Review confirmation emails, abandoned-cart flows, and analytics events to ensure end-to-end tracking. 4. Provide a clear report per store that includes: • Issues discovered, ranked by urgency • Step-by-step instructions—or code snippets where relevant—to resolve each item • Recommended apps or configuration tweaks that could lift conversion rates
Acceptance criteria • A test (or live) order completes successfully through both active payment gateways in each store. • No critical errors remain in Shopify Diagnostics or browser console. • The final report gives me everything I need to fix or delegate outstanding tasks quickly.
If you have solid experience auditing multiple Shopify stores and can turn this around promptly, I’m ready to move forward.

item.title: Fun Staffing Platform Development
item.description:
30-250 USD | I’m launching a staffing agency website that feels lively and approachable yet still runs like clockwork. The core build includes:
• Profile hub – separate, fully editable dashboards for employers and employees so each can manage résumés, company info, availability, and documents. • Job engine – employers post shifts or long-term roles on a calendar view; qualified employees can search, apply, accept, or decline right from the same interface. • Custom markup calculator – I need an on-page tool where I can enter an employee’s hourly rate and instantly show the employer the final bill rate after payroll, insurance, and my margin. The formula and percentages have to be editable from the admin panel. • Invoicing – once a job is completed the system should generate a branded PDF invoice and email it to the employer automatically. • Worker types – the workflow must recognise temporary, temp-to-hire, and direct placement assignments so I can track each category separately. • Authentication – simple email-and-password sign-up/login with password-reset and basic “remember me” functionality.
Please bring a modern tech stack, responsive design principles, and—most important—a fun and creative UI that matches my agency’s upbeat tone. After hand-off I want clear instructions or a short Loom walk-through so I can adjust calculator values, add new job fields, and export invoices without touching code.
If you’re comfortable integrating these modules end-to-end and can suggest the best framework or CMS to keep future scaling painless, let’s talk timelines and milestones.

item.title: Build My Lead Magnet and Email Marketing Funnel
item.description: 300-600 CAD | I’m seeking an experienced marketing automation freelancer to create a professional lead-generation system for my business, Dixie Bennett Soul-Body Alignment. The project includes designing a landing page, implementing a 15-question interactive assessment with scoring logic, integrating an email delivery and automation platform (Mailchimp preferred but open to other cost-effective options), setting up a follow-up email sequence, and connecting the booking pathway to my scheduling page. The deliverables must align with my brand tone: sophisticated, grounded, warm, and insightful. Testing and handover are required to ensure I can manage updates independently. I prefer cost-effective solutions with minimal recurring expenses.

item.title: Electronics Shopify Store & Ads
item.description:
30-250 CAD | I need a full-service partner to get an electronics Shopify store online and profitable. The catalogue will be pulled directly from my Best Buy Marketplace account, so the build must include a reliable integration that keeps stock levels, pricing and orders perfectly in sync.
Because I don’t have any branding yet, you’ll start by creating a fresh visual identity—logo, colour palette and type guidelines that can flow seamlessly from the site to every ad placement.
Once the store is live, I want to drive traffic immediately. That means launching performance-focused campaigns on Facebook, Google, Instagram and TikTok, complete with tracking pixels, conversion events and retargeting audiences.
Deliverables • Brand kit: logo files, colour codes, typography references • Shopify storefront: theme customised for electronics, Best Buy Marketplace integration configured and tested, basic pages (Home, Product, About, Contact, Policies) ready to publish • Marketing setup: ad accounts connected, pixels installed, product feed approved, one starter campaign on each platform (Facebook, Google, Instagram, TikTok) with creative and targeting loaded • Handover: walkthrough video or live call plus a short guide on managing inventory sync and pausing/optimising the ads
Acceptance Criteria – Products import automatically from Best Buy and show correct stock and price – Checkout works from first try on desktop and mobile – All four ad platforms report conversions inside Shopify Analytics within the first 48 hours of launch
If this scope matches your expertise, let’s discuss timeline and any technical details you need from my side.

item.title: Enhance AI-Powered Real Estate SaaS
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | Full-Stack AI Developer for Real Estate SaaS Platform — Long-Term Opportunity
Hourly Budget: $10/hour
Project Overview
I am developing an AI-powered real estate Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) platform that helps real estate professionals evaluate properties, identify comparable sales, and generate data-driven property valuations.
The application is already built and functional. I am looking for a developer who can review the existing codebase, improve the valuation engine, and help me develop the platform further.
I am interested in building a long-term relationship with the right person, starting with a small paid project.
Initial Paid Project
The first assignment is a technical review of the existing application.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Review the existing frontend, backend, database, and application architecture. - Evaluate property data integrations and comparable-sale selection logic. - Assess the deterministic valuation engine and identify weaknesses. - Review the OpenAI integration and ensure AI-generated explanations cannot change the final calculated values or selected comparable sales. - Identify the three most important technical issues or improvement opportunities. - Provide a prioritized development plan with estimated hours and costs.
The initial assignment is for assessment and recommendations. Do not modify or deploy changes to the production application without approval.
Required Skills
- Full-stack web application development. - Python and/or Node.js/TypeScript. - React or Next.js. - PostgreSQL or other relational databases. - REST APIs and third-party data integrations. - OpenAI API and structured AI outputs. - Git and GitHub. - Statistical analysis, regression, or data-driven valuation models.
Experience with real estate technology, property data, comparable-sale analysis, or automated valuation models is a strong advantage.
Experience with Replit-built applications is helpful.
Budget and Long-Term Opportunity
My budget is $10 per hour. I will pay for the initial assignment and subsequent approved work at the agreed hourly rate.
Please propose a focused initial assessment that fits this budget. Before starting, provide an estimate of the hours required and the deliverables.
If we work well together, I am interested in continuing with a reliable developer who can help improve and expand the platform over time.
There may be an opportunity to discuss equity in the future under a separate written agreement. Equity is not guaranteed and is not a substitute for the agreed payment for the initial work.
How to Apply
Please answer these questions:
1. What full-stack SaaS applications have you built? 2. What experience do you have with OpenAI APIs and AI-powered applications? 3. Have you worked with property data, comparable-sale selection, regression, or valuation algorithms? 4. What is your experience with Python, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, and GitHub? 5. Have you worked with applications built using Replit? 6. How many hours per week are you available? 7. How would you approach a technical assessment of this application within a limited budget? 8. Are you interested in a potential long-term collaboration?
Please include links to relevant projects or your GitHub profile.
I value practical problem-solving, honest communication, and clean, maintainable code. I am looking for someone who can understand an existing product, identify its weaknesses, and help make it more reliable and scalable.

item.title: On-Demand Game Card Printing
item.description:
30-250 USD | I publish tabletop games and now want to let players order replacement or extra decks directly from a web portal. The only item I’ll be printing is game cards, and I already have every design press-ready. What I need is a reliable print-on-demand workflow that can handle multiple card sizes, take customer payments, and ship straight to the buyer under plain, neutral packaging.
Here’s what success looks like for me: • Your system (Shopify app, WooCommerce plug-in, or a custom portal—whichever you already master) receives the order, shows real-time pricing, and forwards the print job automatically. • Cards arrive with consistent colour, accurate cutting, and clean edges, no matter which size deck the customer chose. • Turnaround stays inside the promised window and tracking numbers post back to the customer email without my manual touch. • Billing and reporting are transparent so I can see cost, margin, and shipment history at a glance.
I’m happy to start with a small test run so we can fine-tune stock, finishes, and packaging before opening the storefront. Let me know which equipment you use, the card stocks you stock by default, and how you maintain colour fidelity. References or photos of previous card work are a plus.

item.title: Membership Website Design Refresh
item.description:
20-250 GBP | Our membership site needs a fresh look that fully reflects the new brand identity I’ve just developed. I want every public-facing page—layout, imagery, copy, navigation flow—to echo the updated logo, colour palette and typographic system, while keeping the overall structure familiar to current visitors.
Beyond the facelift, I also need a secure members-only area. Access should be granted automatically when a visitor logs in with an email address that matches our paid-up member list in the CMS or a connected database ( to be developed from an existing spread sheet solution). Inside that gated section I’ll be posting time-sensitive discount codes and partner offers, so the pages have to be hidden from search engines and unregistered users.
Key deliverables • Responsive redesign of existing templates, styled with the new colours, fonts and graphic elements I provide. • Streamlined navigation and clearer content hierarchy so users can reach key resources in fewer clicks. • Migration or refresh of existing text, images and media to fit the new design. • Members-only module: email-based authentication, clean dashboard for exclusive discounts, and easy content-update workflow for me. • Final deployment to the live server, plus brief hand-over documentation covering how to add future offers and make edits to the site generally.
The tech stack is flexible as long as it’s stable and easy for a non-developer to maintain. Let me know which platform or framework you think suits these needs best, how you’ll handle the member email whitelist, and a realistic timeline for design concepts, revisions and go-live. the existing website is at http://www.eventsociety.co.uk and currently doesn't feature the members only area. An example of a more complex but similar website would be www.aiea.co.uk

item.title: Lead-Generating IDX Realtor Website

Once everything is live, I should be able to add or edit products myself without breaking the layout, and customers should enjoy a smooth, trustworthy checkout experience. If this sounds like a straightforward project for you, let’s get started—you’ll have direct access to my Wix dashboard as soon as we agree on the timeline.

item.title: Migrate SouthernSkies.biz to Shopify

If this sounds straightforward for you, let’s talk timeline and get SouthernSkies.biz flying smoothly on Shopify.

item.title: WordPress Site Build & Design
item.description:
